rows.evidence: Re-read the original this round (sfu.ca/~kkasa/HarrisonKreps_79.pdf, JET 20, 381-408). Theorem 2: 'Suppose the security price model admits no simple free lunches. Then there is a one-to-one correspondence between equivalent martingale measures P* and' continuous strictly positive linear extensions of pi, via P*(B) = psi(1_B), psi(x) = E*(x). The statement begins on printed p. 390 (page list: p. 390 begins 'strategy theta. At time T'; THEOREM 2 printed before the running head 'MARTINGALES AND ARBITRAGE 391'). The proof runs pp. 391-392: on p. 391, for P* a martingale measure and a simple self-financing theta, 'Iterating this equality yields E*(theta(T).Z(T)) = theta(0).Z(0)'; the converse (the strategy 'buying one share of k at time t if in the event B and then selling at time u' generates a zero-price marketed claim, so E*(Z_k(u)1_B) = E*(Z_k(t)1_B), 'Z_k(t) is a version of E*(Z_k(u)|F_t)') is on p. 392. Simple and self-financing strategies are defined pp. 388-389; Z are prices in units of security 0 (zero interest), i.e. discounted. The span's content is now correct (round-1 fix applied). But its locator 'proof p. 391' cites only one direction of the 'exactly when' it attributes to the proof; the martingale direction is on p. 392.
rows.fix: Set data-locator on line 237 and in key-results row 5 (line 396) to 'Th. 2, p. 390; proof pp. 391-392'.

The claim holds for minimal relative entropy (an EMM when it exists on a finite tree) and for a strictly positive equilibrium SDF.
